title: Aagaya maahe Aza
body:
Aagaya maahe Aza.....
Yaad me shabbir ke phir bichgaya farshe aza
1. Ghar me zehra ke ajab kohram hai barpa huva
Deen e ahmed ko bachane qafela sheh ka chala
Aao matamdaro sab milke kare matam bapa.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Taziya shabbir ka besheer ka jhoola bhi hai
Hai saja ghazi ka parcham sath mashkiza bhi hai
Har azakhana saja hai aaj misle karbalaa......
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maae behene choodiya apne utaare dilfigaar
Chaak karthe hai gareba shaah ke sab ghamgusaar
Har taraf chaayi huvi hai dard aur gham ki Fiza....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hai udaasi chaar janib sare badal hai siyaa
Fatema ke laal ke gham me hai wo bhi mubtela
Roraha hai aasmaa bhi sochkar karbobala....
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Paagayi meraj mehnat zainabe dilgeer ki
Guftugu hothi hai ghar ghar hazrate shabbir ki
Har taraf se aarahi hai wa HUSSAINA ki sada.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Lutgaye ansaro yawar koi jaani bhi nahi
Sogaya darya pe ab hyder ka saani bhi nahi
Rorahi hai shaah ki ghurbat pe baithi sayyada....
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Hai tamanna ye RAIS hojaaye ye nauha qubool
Hashr ke maidaan me ZAINUL se kehdengi batool
Sunke nauha ropadi mei AAGAYA MAAHE AZA
